theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.NonTrivialZero.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ (toZetaZero : Millennium.Zeta.ZetaZero) (in_strip : toZetaZero.point ∈ Millennium.Zeta.CriticalStrip)   (toZetaZero_1 : Millennium.Zeta.ZetaZero) (in_strip_1 : toZetaZero_1.point ∈ Millennium.Zeta.CriticalStrip),   ({ toZetaZero := toZetaZero, in_strip := in_strip } = { toZetaZero := toZetaZero_1, in_strip := in_strip_1 }) =     (toZetaZero = toZetaZero_1)

theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.XiFunction.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (value_at : ℂ → ℂ), sizeOf { value_at := value_at } = 1

theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.ZetaZero.mk.injEq

theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.deltaRH_zero_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (z : Millennium.Zeta.ZetaZero), Millennium.Zeta.deltaRH z = 0 ↔ z.point.re = 1 / 2

theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.knownZeros_on_line
theorems.statement: ∀ γ ∈ Millennium.Zeta.knownGammas, { re := 1 / 2, im := γ }.re = 1 / 2

theorems.name: Millennium.Zeta.rh_equivalence
